dcr_prefix_provenance.reason: Live select stably sorts rounded norm.cdf(a), while deadcut stably sorts rounded a+_DEADCUT_Z. Monotonicity alone does not preserve ordering within finite-precision CDF saturation/ties or differently rounded translated scores. The two stable rosters cannot be assumed identical from dimensions. Existing exact prefix tests intentionally guard this distinction.
